anomalies.expected: The specification states that the TF-Luna LiDAR PR1 is excluded from the board and not wired into any net: 'its pins are free and it is marked on_board: no / excluded from the board; it is not wired into any net.'

anomalies.impact: This adds a 5 V TF-Luna device to the 3.3 V I2C bus. It changes the bus load and voltage levels, can interfere with the ESP32-C6 and ADM3260 primary-side I2C signals, and may damage or prevent normal operation of the bus.

anomalies.expected: The specification's component table states that T3, an AON6407 N-MOSFET, is the ATO solenoid-valve low-side switch and drives the ATO_VALVE net.
